$comment: The real-time control-plane record (#1497): the one definition of the 32-byte
event the main thread, the worklets and hyphon_native exchange. Do not
hand-edit what is derived from it: tools/gen_hyphon_native_types.mjs writes
gen:native-types), and check:exports / pnpm lint fail when either is stale.
record.fields are laid out in order at their natural alignment; the generator
refuses a layout that does not come to record.bytes. types[].symbol names the
type in both languages: k<symbol> in C++ (hyphon::EventType), EventType.<symbol>
in TypeScript. types[].args names the arg slots a type defines; a type without
it leaves all four to the engine. Ids are wire format: never renumber one.
ring is the header of the SPSC ring both sides lay records out in: the JS writer
fills a voice's ring in place inside hyphon_native memory (#1497 P2).

fields.name: frame
fields.doc: absolute frame on the AudioContext clock; 0 (or past) = the next block

fields.name: type
fields.doc: EventType, or an engine-private type at or above kEngine

fields.name: target
fields.doc: what the type addresses: note, param id, pad, note id

fields.name: args
fields.doc: named per type (EventArg in TS, k<Type>Arg<Name> in C++), else engine-defined

types.name: NOTE_ON
types.doc: target = MIDI note, value = velocity (engine's scale); args engine-defined

types.name: ALL_NOTES_OFF
types.doc: release every held note on this frame (MIDI All Notes Off, not a reset)

types.name: PARAM_SET
types.doc: target = engine param id, value = new value

types.name: TRIGGER
types.doc: target = pad / voice, value = velocity; args engine-defined

types.name: PARAM_RAMP
types.doc: target = engine param id, value = end value: a linear ramp from the param's value on this frame

args.name: frames
args.doc: ramp length in frames; 0 = a step, as PARAM_SET

types.name: MUTE
types.doc: target = pad / voice, or kTargetAll; value = 1 mute, 0 unmute. A mute drops that target's scheduled notes and triggers

types.name: NOTE_EXPRESSION
types.doc: target = note id (the MIDI note of the NOTE_ON it shapes, as MIDI 2.0 per-note controllers address it), value = the dimension's value

types.name: CANCEL_NOTES
types.doc: drop the NOTE_ON / NOTE_OFF / TRIGGER events queued before this record, when the voice takes it from its ring (not on a frame): a transport stop. Params still land

$comment: The SPSC ring that carries records between threads (src/shared/rt/eventRing.ts,
hyphon::EventRing): a header of int32 words, then capacity records from
headerBytes. words[].index is the int32 slot; atomic words are the counts the
two ends publish to each other. The producer owns write, dropped and highWater,
the consumer owns read, which sits on its own 64-byte line. magic, version and
capacity are written once, by whoever lays the ring out.

words.name: dropped
words.doc: producer: pushes refused because the ring was full

words.name: highWater
words.doc: producer: most records ever unread at once

words.name: magic
words.doc: ring.magic, little-endian, once the ring is laid out

words.name: capacity
words.doc: records the ring holds; a power of two

engineBase.doc: first engine-private type (e.g. the drum kit's hat choke)

targets.doc: every pad / voice of the engine (MUTE)
